program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Grid lines contain no cell-interior fill color; their crossings are the encoded values.
    rs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if fill not in row]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h))]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rs, rs[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cs, cs[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            # A uniformly colored set of marked corners fills that cell with the mark;
            # otherwise retain the interior color.
            if corners[0] == corners[1] == corners[2] == corners[3] and corners[0] >= 7:
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
